prompt:
A force of magnitude 75 N acts at an angle of 35 degrees above the horizontal.
(a) Calculate the magnitude of the horizontal component of the force. [1]
(b) Calculate the magnitude of the vertical component of the force. [1]

answer.text:
(a) 75 * cos(35 degrees) = 61.4 N (or 61 N).
(b) 75 * sin(35 degrees) = 43.0 N (or 43 N).

mark_scheme: Part (a) [1 mark]: 75 * cos(35 degrees) = 61.4 N (accept 61 N).
Part (b) [1 mark]: 75 * sin(35 degrees) = 43.0 N (accept 43 N).
hints: The angle is measured from the horizontal.
Horizontal component is adjacent (cosine); vertical component is opposite (sine).
solution:
(a) F_horizontal = 75 * cos(35 degrees) = 75 * 0.8192 = 61.4 N.
(b) F_vertical = 75 * sin(35 degrees) = 75 * 0.5736 = 43.0 N.
